text: Disputed: whether F-0164's "NO STORIES -> SPEC-AMEND" stalemate (3 sessions, none closing it) was a content disagreement or a structural one a 4th attempt would also hit. A spec-amend session told to derive Stories from "the Feature's spec, plan and landed Tasks" (asf/feeder/rows.py:425-427) had two sources that disagreed on the count, and that contradiction, not the design, is what three sessions could not close — a fourth would hit the same wall. Upheld: the spec now follows the already-approved replan. stories: names S-39702 alone; the ## Stories list strikes S-39700 and S-39701 as cut, pointing at the replan, with their design (## The design §§1-4, now docs/specs/f-0164.md:166-328) left intact and unlabelled as waste, exactly as the replan called it — reusable verbatim by whichever new card inherits it. T-0756's own design, writes and acceptance are untouched.
